{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify the six QA rows with revenue = 999999.99
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Found {len(qa_rows)} QA rows with revenue = 999999.99")

# Remove these rows
df_clean = df[~df['revenue'].isin(['999999.99'])]

# Verify removal
print(f"Remaining rows after removing QA rows: {len(df_clean)}")

# Check that no other rows have commas (to confirm only QA rows had them)
has_commas = df_clean['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False)
print(f"Rows with commas in cleaned revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")"}
